title: Receive reunion without forgetting the Doer
summary: Separation and reunion both move within the Creator's doing. When closeness returns, the soul receives it as grace instead of turning reunion into possession.
takeaway: Receive reunion as the Creator's doing, not your own rescue story.
lifeApplication: When a relationship, opening, or prayer feels restored, do not seize it as proof of your control. Give thanks, serve gently, and let the Doer remain the Doer.

source.shortMeaning: Reunion is received under the Lord's pleasure and the Creator's doing.
source.lifeApplication: When reunion comes, receive it under the Lord's pleasure before claiming it.

evidence.coreClaim: Reunion is received under the Lord's pleasure and the Creator's doing.
evidence.turn: Even restoration becomes humble when the Creator remains the only Doer.
